[[File:Umbarans-SWE.png|right|thumb|Umbaran Soldiers of the Umbaran militia]]
'''Umbaran soldiers''' were [[Umbaran/Legends|members]] of the [[Umbaran militia]] who served their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] as militants.

==History==
The Umbarans were highly trained in combat, which proved effective during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|assault]] on their [[Umbara/Legends|homeworld]]. They caused heavy casualties on the Republic side using the cover of darkness<ref name="COK">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref> which continuously covered Umbara.<ref name="SWE-Umbara">{{SWE|locations|umbara|Umbara}}</ref>

==Equipment==
They were encased inside a protective suit which covered their faces.<ref name="Darkness on Umbara">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref><ref name="The General episode">{{TCW|The General (episode)}}</ref><ref name="Plan of Dissent">{{TCW|Plan of Dissent}}</ref><ref name="COK" /> Their helmets fed its wearer a potent gas mixture that kept them ready for combat, improving their reflexes and aggression level.<ref name="the-general-trivia-1">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep408|text="The General" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|Slide 1 &mdash; "Breathing Uneasy"}}</ref> They utilized their [[Umbaran blaster pistol/Legends|standard blasters]]<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures video game">{{TCWA|Shop}}</ref> but also made use of other advanced weapons such as the [[Millicreep/Legends|millicreep]]<ref name="SWE-Umbarans">{{SWE|groups|umbarans|Umbarans}}</ref> and the [[Umbaran hover tank/Legends|Umbaran hover tank]].<ref name="SWE-Umbaran hover tank">{{SWE|technology|umbaranhovertank|Umbaran hover tank}}</ref>

{{Soldier-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
According to the trivia section for "[[The General (episode)|The General]]" on the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' website [[StarWars.com]], inspiration for the pressure-suited Umbaran soldiers includes the [http://www.robotech.com/infopedia/encyclopedia/viewterm.php?id=37 Zentraedi] from [http://www.robotech.com Robotech] and the [[Wikipedia:Sardaukar|Sardaukar]] from'' Dune''.<ref name="the-general-trivia-1" />
